instruction: Set up cross-platform synchronization so this document automatically syncs between your desktop, tablet, and smartphone for seamless editing on any device.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in cross-platform synchronization features. While cloud storage services can be used externally, there is no native automatic sync system for seamless multi-device editing within LibreOffice.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer lacks native cross-platform synchronization capabilities
